concept: A brave first-spark sanctuary built from bold fire forms and warm sunrise stone.
floor: One continuous smooth ember-coral clay floor across the full top face, with broad warm shading and no grass, tiles, symbols, rings, or repeated pattern.
main_structure: One chunky curved ram-horn-inspired arch at the rear, built from two abstract symmetrical cream stone curls around a broad glowing sunrise slab without depicting an animal.
side_props: three large rounded crimson rocks on the upper-left edge
two broad coral flame-leaf sculptures on the upper-right edge

perimeter.material: one continuous rounded warm-cream stone wall with broad coral cap blocks

lighting: soft sunrise ambient light with two broad amber brazier glows
must_keep: exact canonical camera, canvas, footprint, stairs, tapered underside, and padding
entire bottom/front half as quiet open ember-clay floor
all additions inside the original silhouette
must_exclude: creature, animal, ram head, egg, or familiar baked into the bitmap
zodiac glyph, constellation, text, center circle, platform, plaza, ring, rug, path, or indentation
bridges, clouds, watermark, external shadow, sparks, tiny stones, cracks, specks, or dense clutter
